attchmntText: Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated 0 , , titled "Press Release".
voiceSummary: Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited announced the opening of Taj Yelahanka in Bengaluru on 20th November 2026. The 256-key luxury hotel is located on International Airport Road and is operated by The Indian Hotels Company Limited under a long-term management agreement. The property features 40,000 square feet of event space, including a 10,000 square foot pillarless Grand Ballroom. The hotel will be inaugurated by Karnataka Chief Minister D. K. Shivakumar. This launch expands Krishna GVK's portfolio to seven hotels and 1,500 keys. The company holds an adjacent 4-acre land parcel with potential for approximately 350 additional rooms and office space, subject to approvals. The company was formerly known as TAJ GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited.

attchmntText: Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press release".
voiceSummary: KRISHNA GVK Luxury Hotels Limited reported financial results for the quarter and half year ending September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue for Q2 was Rs. 137.31 Cr with a profit after tax of Rs. 38.53 Cr. Half year standalone revenue was Rs. 246.73 Cr with a profit after tax of Rs. 57.20 Cr. Consolidated Q2 revenue was Rs. 168.56 Cr with a profit after tax of Rs. 26.55 Cr. Half year consolidated revenue was Rs. 334.67 Cr with a profit after tax of Rs. 58.21 Cr. Subsidiary Green Woods Palaces and Resorts Private Limited reported Q2 revenue of INR 54.20 Crores and half year revenue of INR 110.89 Crores. The company completed renovation of 24 rooms at Taj Deccan, Hyderabad. Taj Yelahanka, Bengaluru, is scheduled to open for commercial operations on November 20th 2026.

attchmntText: Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 3853 lakhs for the quarter and 5720 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations stood at 11290 lakhs for the quarter and 22214 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 6.14 for the quarter and 9.12 for the half year. The board also approved the disclosure of related party transactions for the half year. The statutory auditors, M. Bhaskara Rao & Co., conducted a limited review and reported no material misstatements. The company received dividend income of 2295 lakhs from its subsidiary, Green Woods Palaces and Resorts Private Limited. The company's name was changed from Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited to Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited with effect from October 30, 2026.
